basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm Alex, a college student from the Midwest, currently exploring the world of Reddit. I have a keen interest in social issues, particularly around accessibility and disability rights, which led me to r/disabledliving. When I'm not studying, I enjoy learning about new technologies and their societal impacts. I spend most of my time online in the evenings and enjoy connecting with like-minded individuals. I'm single and tend to use Reddit as a way to unwind and expand my knowledge beyond my college curriculum.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a foundational knowledge in social sciences, thanks to my coursework in university. I've also gained insights into disability advocacy through online resources and community discussions. My understanding of technology comes from both my academic interests and self-directed learning online.
